description: Use this when someone asks whether their visa is approved or wants its file: 'is my visa approved', 'هل تمت الموافقة على تأشيرتي؟', 'одобрили ли мою визу', 'क्या मेरा वीज़ा मंज़ूर हो गया?'. After submission: how it was filed (filing: government, an acknowledgement from the government; form_delivered, a form-only country's completed form handed to the applicant, which the government never acknowledges to us; unconfirmed), the decision, and a 15-minute link to the issued visa file when one exists.
name: visarun_get_result
title: Get the filing and decision
